info.title: RustVault API
info.description: HTTP API for RustVault account, authentication, security settings, and encrypted vault storage. Binary vault contents remain client-side encrypted.

401.description: Missing, expired, or revoked access token

post.summary: Begin account deletion using a passkey
post.description: Returns WebAuthn assertion options. Complete the challenge using DELETE step 2.

200.description: Passkey assertion options and operation ID

delete.summary: Confirm account deletion using a passkey

204.description: Account, related records, and vault deleted

401.description: Access token or passkey assertion rejected

422.description: Confirmation operation expired or was not found

post.summary: Begin account deletion using password and TOTP

get.description: Returns the exact binary vault payload as `application/octet-stream`. The payload is client-side encrypted.

put.description: Sends the raw binary encrypted vault, not JSON. Version must strictly exceed the stored version. Maximum body size is configured by the server.

413.description: Payload exceeds configured maximum body size

422.description: Version is not greater than the stored version

200.description: Metadata for the authenticated user's vault

get.description: Returns a small status document when the HTTP service is responding.
